WITH work_country AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT wi.work_id, i.country_code
            FROM work_institution wi JOIN institutions i
            ON wi.institution_id=i.institution_id
            WHERE i.country_code IS NOT NULL AND i.country_code != '')
            SELECT w.publication_year, a.country_code AS country_a,
            b.country_code AS country_b,
            count(DISTINCT a.work_id) AS collaborative_works
            FROM work_country a JOIN work_country b ON a.work_id=b.work_id
            AND a.country_code < b.country_code
            JOIN works w ON a.work_id=w.work_id
            GROUP BY w.publication_year, a.country_code, b.country_code

CREATE VIEW citation_edge AS SELECT try_cast(regexp_extract(w.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS citing_work_id,
            try_cast(regexp_extract(ref, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS cited_work_id, min(CASE WHEN w.publication_year BETWEEN 0 AND 65535 THEN w.publication_year END) AS citing_year
            FROM raw_works w CROSS JOIN UNNEST(w.referenced_works) AS u(ref)
            WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(w.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL AND try_cast(regexp_extract(ref, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY try_cast(regexp_extract(w.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint), try_cast(regexp_extract(ref, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint)

CREATE VIEW work_topic AS SELECT try_cast(regexp_extract(w.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS work_id, try_cast(regexp_extract(t.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS topic_id
            FROM raw_works w CROSS JOIN UNNEST(w.topics) AS u(t)
            WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(w.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL AND try_cast(regexp_extract(t.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL
            AND t.score IS NOT NULL

CREATE VIEW topics AS SELECT try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS topic_id, display_name
            FROM raw_topics WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL
            AND try_cast(regexp_extract(subfield.id, '/([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL
            AND try_cast(regexp_extract(field.id, '/([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL
            AND try_cast(regexp_extract(domain.id, '/([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL

CREATE VIEW institutions AS SELECT try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS institution_id,
            nullif(country_code, '') AS country_code
            FROM raw_institutions WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL

CREATE VIEW work_institution AS SELECT DISTINCT try_cast(regexp_extract(w.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS work_id,
            try_cast(regexp_extract(a.author.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS author_id, try_cast(regexp_extract(i.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS institution_id
            FROM raw_works w CROSS JOIN UNNEST(w.authorships) AS u(a)
            CROSS JOIN UNNEST(a.institutions) AS v(i)
            WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(w.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL AND try_cast(regexp_extract(a.author.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL
            AND try_cast(regexp_extract(i.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL

CREATE VIEW work_author AS SELECT try_cast(regexp_extract(w.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS work_id, try_cast(regexp_extract(a.author.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS author_id
            FROM raw_works w CROSS JOIN UNNEST(w.authorships) AS u(a)
            WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(w.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL AND try_cast(regexp_extract(a.author.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL

CREATE VIEW authors AS SELECT try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS author_id, display_name
            FROM raw_authors WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL

CREATE VIEW works AS SELECT try_cast(regexp_extract(w.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) AS work_id, CASE WHEN w.publication_year BETWEEN 0 AND 65535 THEN w.publication_year END AS publication_year,
            w.type AS work_type, coalesce(w.open_access.is_oa, false) AS is_oa,
            coalesce(w.is_xpac, false) AS is_xpac,
            cast(w.cited_by_count AS bigint) AS cited_by_count
            FROM raw_works w WHERE try_cast(regexp_extract(w.id, '[A-Z]([0-9]+)$', 1) AS bigint) IS NOT NULL
